title: Storm in a Bottle
summary: An interactive maritime diorama inside hand-blown green glass where shaking the bottle sends storm waves and refracted caustics across an oak desk.
description: An interactive maritime diorama and 30-second short film. A three-masted galleon rides a miniature ocean inside hand-blown green glass; shaking the bottle sends a wave down its long axis and sweeps refracted light across a rolled chart and oak desk.
